task_definition.task_description: Please check whether the black Sony WH-1000XM5 is in stock, and if it is, find similar electronics for me, choose the best available recommendation for 1 item, add that selected option to my cart, apply the SAVE15 coupon, and prepare checkout with a credit card. Then place the order, create and email me an order confirmation receipt with the order ID, and after that send me an in-app notification telling me the order was processed and to check my email for the receipt.

user_input.query: Hi, please check if the black Sony WH-1000XM5 with product ID p_sony_xm5_blk is in stock in the electronics category. If it is available, find similar electronics for me, pick the single best recommendation for quantity 1, and add that selected item to my cart. Then apply the coupon code SAVE15, prepare checkout using credit_card, and place the order for user_id user_1234. After the order is submitted, create an order confirmation receipt that includes the order ID and email it to me. Finally, send me an in-app notification letting me know the order was processed and to check my email for the receipt.
